outline: 先修課程：3002012或負責教授同意。介紹各種不同分析方法（如能量法及Castigliano定理）、破壞理論、材料選用、可靠度概念、軸及軸承、離合器及煞車器、傳動元件(如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪)、軸聯接器、飛輪、彈簧等。
schedule:
1. Introduction1
2. Material selection
3. Fundamental principles (stress and deformation(i)
4. Fundamental principles (stress and deformation (ii)
5. Failure resulting from static loading
6. Fatigue failure resulting from variable loading (i)
7. Fatigue failure resulting from variable loading (ii)
8. Design of shaft
9. Midterm
10. Design of spring
11. Design of non-permanent joints
12 Design of permanent joints
13. Rolling contact bearings and journal bearing
14. Gear design
15. Flexible Mechanical elements
16. Principles of form synthesis
17. Designing with plastic materials
18. Final Exam.
assessment: 作業,小考, 課堂表現 35 % ,期中考 30%, 期末考 35%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

Design of machine elements (8th edition 2004)(SI) by Spotts, Shoup, Hornberger,  Pearson/ Prentice Hall
